name: Mana Shock
rule_excerpt: | F3 | **The Mana Shock sign** (rules 1.56, the Mana Shock, 16 Nov 2026): the state a Soul caster is in after a Mana Short until its Strain is back at the limit (it costs a share of max HP each turn) | Wanted. A placeholder sign is in (`art/icons/conditions/mana-shock.svg`, catalog `cond-mana-shock`); the game shows the word MANA SHOCK in the damage colour on the token and the Strain row | A cracked violet heart with a red fracture through it, still glowing past its edge (a heart that won't cool), readable at 32 px | The condition-sign family (`mode: sign`), damage ink `#F65157` over the Soul violet; no Wick | `art/icons/conditions/mana-shock.png` |
